tasks.title: Multi-Agent Parallel Environment & Context Engine Setup

tasks.title: Sinhala Tokenizer Fertility & Compression Benchmark Script
tasks.description: Port and standardize the Google Colab token fertility script from the research PDF into scripts/evaluate_tokenizer.py for evaluating Gemma-2/3, Qwen-2.5, and SinLlama on Sinhala and Singlish sentences.

tasks.title: Audio Ear Pipeline (Silero VAD + Faster-Whisper Sinhala STT)
tasks.description: Implement src/sinmate/audio/vad.py and src/sinmate/audio/stt.py using Silero VAD for low-latency voice detection and Faster-Whisper with Sinhala checkpoints.

tasks.title: Brain Engine & Spoken Sinhala Multi-Persona Templates
tasks.description: Implement src/sinmate/brain/personas.py with four dynamic personas (Best Friend, Special Partner, Mother Figure, Teacher) and Ollama LLM client integration.

tasks.title: Mouth Pipeline (Sinhala VITS / Piper TTS Voice Synthesis)
tasks.description: Implement src/sinmate/tts/vits_tts.py to wrap native Sinhala VITS models and stream sentence-by-sentence synthesized audio.

tasks.title: Heart & Memory System (SQLite Fact Store + Spontaneous Heartbeat)
tasks.description: Implement src/sinmate/memory/db.py for conversation history and user profile facts, and src/sinmate/proactive/heartbeat.py for time/silence-based proactive conversation prompts.

tasks.title: Full-Duplex Orchestrator & Barge-In Audio Loop
tasks.description: Integrate Ears, Brain, Mouth, and Heart into an async real-time conversation loop with immediate barge-in interruption capability.

tasks.title: Conversational Sinhala Dataset Generation & SFT/DPO Pipeline
tasks.description: Create data curation and synthetic generation scripts for 5k-10k colloquial spoken Sinhala multi-turn dialogues with conversational fillers.

tasks.title: Teacher-batch ingest script (scripts/ingest_teacher_batches.py)
tasks.description: Read reviewed teacher JSONL (output of scripts/apply_critic_verdicts.py, e.g. data/accepted_dialogs.jsonl). Validate schema + rules, map free-text categories onto the 9 ADR-006 categories (or drop the field), flag hearsay/health-claim/gendered lines for review, NFC, dedupe, inject the exact COMPACT_PERSONA_LINES system prompt per persona (one variant only), assign sinmate_NNNNN ids, split train/val, print stats vs the target mix in docs/dataset_generation_prompts.md. Also build DPO pairs from data/rejected_dialogs.jsonl (line n = nth accepted dialogue).

tasks.title: Scale teacher dataset: targeted batches (grief, crisis, identity, panic) then ~1,000-4,000 dialogues
tasks.description: Pilot (73 accepted) has 0 grief_and_loss, 0 crisis_support, 0 identity_honesty, only 5 panic. Run Prompt 2 for those first, with 3 added lines: category must come from the allowed list; no hearsay/health claims; mother persona prefers දරුවෝ/ඔයා over පුතේ. User (native speaker) must read all crisis/grief dialogues in full. Then Prompt 3 (critic) -> scripts/apply_critic_verdicts.py -> ingest.

tasks.title: ADR-006 cognitive pipeline stages 1-3 and 5 (input type, emotion, category, guardrail)
tasks.description: No code exists yet for stage 1 (input type), 2 (emotion), 3 (category) and 5 (deterministic guardrail). Brain currently does persona + generate only. See .context/ARCHITECTURE.md section 3 and ADR-006.

tasks.title: Fine-tune v2 + GGUF export + live re-test against Brain
tasks.description: After the dataset is rebuilt: add response-only loss masking to notebook 02, retrain on Colab T4 (fp32 compute, auto-detected), export GGUF, import into Ollama, rerun the Brain live test against it. Also: remove Example: lines from PERSONA_PROMPTS (base model copies them), fix the \u0DCAF typo in normalizer.py Yansaya regex, make tests/TestRunner stop appending 'Automated test message' to .context/BLACKBOARD.md.
